Black pepper.', 'using System;'), and, in French or Italian, almost every preposition or article (de, la, dans, au, à, avec, con, in, di) whatever follows, even a person. In English it stays below ~0.9 when every slot holds a person or pronoun ('talked to her mother', 'baked by Grandma', 'shared with Uncle Joe'), on comma lists of personal names, on 'in' governed by an abstract noun or adjective ('a role in', 'interested in', 'differences in'), on infinitival 'to', and on content nouns and sentence-final periods of person-centred narrative.
